title: A-S 541 - Graphic Design: Advanced Design
description: Provides an opportunity for the advanced study of artistic and technical solutions for graphic design problems. Prospecting for employment, working conditions, avenues for advancement, pricing work, and the legal responsibilities of the artist-designer to the client-agency discussed. Students conclude this course with the presentation of a portfolio demonstrating their ability to do quality work which meets the highest professional standards. Nine studio hours per week.
prerequisites: A-S 540 (with a grade of B or better) and Portfolio Review
